paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Levi: Arakhin 16b. R. Yochanan questioned him: Jerusalem Kol HaKelim, halakhah 1. Rav Acha and R. Yosah, in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Kelal Gadol. R. Acha and R. Y. ben Levi [ריב״ל], in Rabbi's name: Jerusalem Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 1. [The checked text names both R. Yehudah ben Levi and R. Yehoshua ben Levi alongside R. Acha.] R. Zeira said: Abba Antoli came to R. Yehudah ben Levi, who sent word to his son Menachem—Demai 5:9. [At 5:8:8 in the checked edition, he asks Menachem to prepare the tithes for Antoli.]
